summary: Cohesive Phase 2 architecture for the Hyperlocal Neighborhood Directory & Spot Mapper pre-seeded in Central London (Covent Garden / West End, 51.5118, -0.1280, zoom 13) across all 8 standalone web stacks. On initial load, the app renders a 2D vector Google Map (mapId: "DEMO_MAP_ID", internalUsageAttributionIds: ["gmp_git_agentsamples_v1.0.0"]) with a 5km (5000m) radius circle and executes a live Places API (New) Nearby Search across four core categories (restaurant, cafe, museum, park), rendering color-coded AdvancedMarkerElement + PinElement pins and populating the directory sidebar. Users can search addresses or neighborhoods via PlaceAutocompleteElement (<gmp-place-autocomplete>, listening to gmp-select and calling event.placePrediction.toPlace().fetchFields()) or forward Geocoding, filter by category within the 5km radius, inspect live ratings, priceLevel, regularOpeningHours.weekdayDescriptions (avoiding beta-only Place.isOpen() on the weekly channel), and customer reviews in a slide-over details drawer, compare up to 3 places side-by-side, and click anywhere on the map to reverse-geocode human-readable street addresses and coordinates to inspect or pin session-scoped community spots. Pure client stacks (static-vanilla-js, react-vite, sveltekit, vue-vite, angular) call Maps JS importLibrary() classes exclusively (Place.searchNearby, Place.searchByText, Place.fetchFields, PlaceAutocompleteElement, Geocoder) with zero CORS traps; full-stack frameworks (nextjs, python-fastapi, nodejs-web) additionally route Places API (New) and Geocoding REST calls through local /api/... BFF endpoints with explicit X-Goog-Api-Key, X-Goog-FieldMask, X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff, and X-Frame-Options: SAMEORIGIN headers, bound strictly to 127.0.0.1. All stacks strictly enforce zero deprecated APIs (no Marker, PlacesService, Autocomplete, DirectionsService, DistanceMatrixService, HeatmapLayer, drawing, or gmpx-*), no hardcoded API keys, no innerHTML DOM sinks, and no LLM-fabricated place data.
gmp_products_used: Maps JavaScript API (2D Vector Map, AdvancedMarkerElement, PinElement, InfoWindow, Circle)
Places API (New) — PlaceAutocompleteElement, Place.searchNearby, Place.searchByText, Place.fetchFields
Places API (New) Web Service REST (places:searchNearby, places:searchText, places/{placeId}) for full-stack BFF routes
Geocoding API (Maps JS Geocoder and REST /maps/api/geocode/json) for forward and reverse geocoding
seed_search_query: restaurants, cafes, museums, and parks in Central London
ui_layout_summary: Split-screen desktop / responsive mobile layout: (1) Fixed 64px top header bar with app title, PlaceAutocompleteElement address/neighborhood search input + Geocode button, quick Central London neighborhood preset selector (Covent Garden, Soho, South Bank, Bloomsbury), 5km radius badge/circle toggle, and Comparison panel toggle button with active count. (2) Left directory sidebar (400px width on desktop, collapsible bottom/top drawer on mobile) containing category filter chips (All, Restaurants, Cafes, Museus/Museums, Parks), live place count & active neighborhood status bar, scrollable directory cards showing live rating, review count, price level, today's opening hours, Compare toggle, and Inspect action, plus a session-scoped Community Spots list. (3) Main full-height interactive 2D vector map canvas (height: calc(100vh - 64px), min-height: 520px) displaying the 5km search radius circle and categorized AdvancedMarkerElement PinElement markers with standard click listeners (weekly-channel safe). (4) Right-side floating Place Details Drawer / Map-Click Reverse-Geocode Inspector showing live ratings, priceLevel, weekdayDescriptions, reviews, photos, and a form to pin reverse-geocoded community spots. (5) Docked bottom side-by-side Comparison Panel comparing up to 3 selected places across rating, review volume, price level, category, hours, and address.
